item.title: (no subject)
item.description:
Is it acceptable to rage quit in online games to save your pride, your honor and your dignity?
So that your family name is never tarnished for generations to come?
Would you unplug the cable if it came down to the last resort?
Did you ever do it?

Think about this rank, these player points you worked a whole football season to accumulate.
